name: danger-guard
description: Asks or blocks before destructive commands and writes to sensitive paths.

allowSudo.title: Allow sudo without asking
allowSudo.description: Skip the confirmation for commands that use sudo.

forcePush.title: Force push
forcePush.description: What to do before git push --force.

recursiveDelete.title: Recursive delete (rm -rf)
recursiveDelete.description: What to do before a recursive or forced rm outside the root and home cases, which are always refused.

extraCommands.title: Extra commands to confirm
extraCommands.description: Regular expressions for commands you want to be asked about, comma separated. Example: terraform apply,docker system prune

extraPaths.title: Extra protected paths
extraPaths.description: Regular expressions for file paths that need confirmation before a write, comma separated. Example: /prod/,\.pem$
